title_en: 10x leverage: more money, or more risk?
title_zh: 十倍杠杆，是钱变多，还是风险变大？
goal_en: Tell margin, notional position and return on margin apart, and see what changing leverage does when position size is fixed.
goal_zh: 分清保证金、名义仓位和收益率，理解固定仓位下杠杆设置的效果。

shots.visual_en: Sam feeds 100 into a '10x' machine, expecting 1,000 in cash to come out the other end.
shots.visual_zh: 小白把100投入“十倍”机器，期待另一端吐出1000现金。

lines.en: If I use ten times, does the exchange give me 900?
lines.zh: 开十倍，平台是不是送我九百？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E19' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第19集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: 10x leverage: more money, or more risk?
onscreen_text_zh: 十倍杠杆，是钱变多，还是风险变大？

shots.visual_en: The machine produces no cash; it enlarges the notional position it can carry to 1,000; the 100 stays labelled 'margin'.
shots.visual_zh: 机器不吐现金，而是把可承担的合约名义仓位放大到1000；100仍标保证金。

lines.en: It's not free cash. Simply put, 100 of margin controlling a 1,000 position is 10x leverage. Price moves act on the position, and your margin takes the profit or loss.
lines.zh: 不是送现金。简化来说，一百保证金控制一千名义仓位，是十倍杠杆。价格变化作用在仓位上，你的保证金承担对应盈亏。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching model · not any exchange's real rules
onscreen_text_zh: 教学模型 · 非任何交易所真实规则

shots.visual_en: With 100 margin: 10x = 1,000 position, 20x = 2,000 position; both move 1% against.
shots.visual_zh: 100保证金下，10倍仓位1000，20倍仓位2000；两边同时反向波动1%。

lines.en: Ignoring fees, a 1% move against you loses about 10 on a 1,000 position, and about 20 on a 2,000 position. The percentage looks small, but on a small margin it can hurt.
lines.zh: 暂不计费用，价格反向百分之一，一千仓位大约亏十，两千仓位大约亏二十。百分比看起来很小，对小额保证金却可能很明显。

shots.visual_en: Position fixed at 1,000; only the leverage setting changes. The P&L curve stays the same; the initial margin required changes.
shots.visual_zh: 把仓位固定在1000，只改杠杆设置，盈亏曲线不变、初始保证金需求改变。

lines.en: Here's an easy mistake. If the position size stays the same and you only change the leverage setting, the P&L in money for the same price move doesn't double. What changes is the margin required and your risk buffer.
lines.zh: 还有一个容易弄错的地方：如果仓位大小没变，只调整杠杆设置，同样价格变化的金额盈亏不会凭空翻倍；主要变化在保证金需求和风险缓冲。

shots.visual_en: The inverse-leverage shortcut 10% = 1/10 gets a stamp 'NOT the real liquidation formula'; maintenance margin and fee cards appear.
shots.visual_zh: 倒数杠杆公式10%=1/10被标“不是实际强平公式”；费用和维持保证金卡出现。

lines.en: Real liquidation also involves maintenance margin, the mark price and fees. You can't say 10x always liquidates at exactly a 10% drop. Don't use this shortcut for real trades.
lines.zh: 实际强平还涉及维持保证金、标记价格与费用，不能说十倍就一定恰好跌百分之十才爆仓。不要靠这个近似值设置真实交易。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Does 10x leverage make your win rate ten times higher too?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：十倍杠杆让胜率也变成十倍吗？

lines.en: It magnifies how the position hits your money, not your judgement.
lines.zh: 放大的是仓位对本金的影响，不是你的判断能力。

onscreen_text_zh: 十倍杠杆 = 十倍胜率？ 不会

lines.zh: 保证金还没归零，为什么就可能出局？下一集：那条看不见的线。

page_cta.line_en: Switch between 'fixed margin' and 'fixed position' in the margin risk simulator below.
page_cta.line_zh: 在下方保证金风险模拟器里切换“固定保证金”和“固定仓位”。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Choose 'fixed margin' and then 'fixed position' mode, and watch the money P&L after a price move.
exercise.task_zh: 分别选择固定保证金和固定仓位模式，观察价格变动后的金额盈亏。
exercise.answer_en: With fixed margin, higher leverage enlarges the notional position. With a fixed position, money P&L doesn't grow automatically.
exercise.answer_zh: 固定保证金提高杠杆会扩大名义仓位；固定仓位则不自动扩大金额盈亏。
